description: Searches Chain Daddy's documentation (docs.chaindaddy.io): guides for launching and running a token, token pages, alerts, creator stores, Crown Apps, and the developer API, CLI and SDKs. Returns the best-matching pages, each with its title, a one-line summary, its path and its URL.

limit.description: How many pages to return (1-20, default 5).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words (e.g. "store keys", "launch fees").

name: search_docs

path.description: The page's path in the docs.

title: Search the docs
